data.one_liner: Utility to collect and dispose StreamSubscriptions and Sinks in Dart/Flutter.
data.what_it_does: DisposeBag lets you add StreamSubscriptions and Sinks and dispose them all at once. It provides extension methods for easy disposal and removal. Works on all Dart platforms.
use_when: You have multiple stream subscriptions or sinks that need coordinated cleanup
You want a lightweight way to avoid memory leaks in Flutter widgets
You prefer a simple API without additional dependencies
avoid_when: You need a full‑featured dependency‑injection or state‑management solution
You require code‑generation or advanced resource handling
strengths: Very small and easy to understand
Null‑safe and works on all platforms
weaknesses: Only handles streams and sinks, no broader resource management
No built‑in logging configuration beyond a static logger

alternatives.name: async
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides utilities like StreamQueue and other async helpers that can also help manage stream lifecycles
